A1.justification: Both PDFs contain Low-Rank Thinning with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–L. The complete material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V7 reports original attention-approximation experiments in Tables 3–4, mortgage-classification experiments in Figure 1, and Higgs two-sample testing experiments in Figure 2, with supplementary analyses in Appendix L.

after.justification: V8 retains these original experimental results in Tables 3–4, Figures 1–2, and Appendix L.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–3 and the appendix algorithms retain the same procedures and components. The revised runtime bounds do not reflect changes to the algorithms.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet classification, BigGAN image generation, mortgage classification, and Higgs two-sample testing coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 3–4 and Figures 1–2: the same attention approximations, RR/CD-GraB variants, and Subsampling/W-Block tests are evaluated.

E3.justification: The evaluation metrics, model configurations, sample sizes, training settings, and timing procedures in Sections 4–6 and Appendix L are unchanged. No new experimental protocols are introduced.

E4.justification: Figures L.1–L.2 retain the same gradient-spectrum and approximate-rank analysis and CTT error-inflation analysis. No ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses are added or removed.

E5.justification: Both retain five-seed accuracy and SGD reporting, batch-based runtime standard deviations, and power estimates with standard errors across 1000 independent trials.

E6.justification: The empirical values and plotted results in Tables 3–4 and Figures 1–2 and L.1–L.2 are identical. For example, Thinformer retains 82.18 ± 0.05% Top-1 accuracy and 30.54 FID.

T1.justification: V8 corrects KH-Compress's runtime from O(n_out^2) to O(n_out^2 log n_out) in Table 1, Section 2.1, and Appendix B.5, and correspondingly revises Thinformer's thinning-stage cost in Section 4.1. Table 2 replaces log(n ||V||_max) inside Thinformer's square-root factor with log(γ ||V||_max log n). These are localized bound corrections and refinements; the main theorem statements and remaining mathematical arguments are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and concluding impact statement retain the same contributions: low-rank thinning guarantees and applications to attention approximation, SGD reordering, and near-linear-time testing.

C2.justification: The interpretations of low-rank adaptivity, experimental findings, and applicability remain unchanged, including Appendix L.2's discussion of the practical limitations of SBW's gradient-bound requirement.

D1.justification: Appendix L retains the same software versions, hardware, hyperparameters, timing instructions, and implementation information. Code-access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to prior thinning, attention, SGD, and testing research are unchanged.

P1.justification: Internal appendix references change systematically from App./Apps. to Sec./Secs., and the arXiv version/date marking is updated. Section organization and almost all prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 is slightly rescaled and re-spaced around its revised formula, with local text reflow. The figures, table structures, captions, and overall arrangement are otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: V8 fixes the omitted logarithmic runtime factor: Appendix B.5 already contained a logarithmic expression in v7, but incorrectly simplified it to O(n_out^2). Propagating the correction and refining Table 2 improve mathematical accuracy and consistency. The algorithms, central guarantees, and empirical evidence remain substantially unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
